ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Potential Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: Investigate potential fraud in government programs, including SNAP and housing programs
questions: What are the most common types of fraud in government programs?
How can we prevent fraud in government programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in government spending. I recommend starting with a review of recent investigations and reports of potential fraud, and then following up with interviews with officials and experts in the field.
